items.t: Oil leak from timing cover seal on V6
items.job: Reseal timing case cover (engine lowered)
items.note: PistonHeads says the job was originally about 40 hours; independent specialists may take less time.

items.t: Transfer case vibration or jerking at low speed
items.job: Replace transfer case
items.note: Porsche extended US coverage to 7 years/unlimited miles; check your VIN with a dealer.

items.t: Cracked fuel pump flange can leak fuel (recall)
items.job: Rework or replace fuel pump flange
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Brake booster damaged during assembly (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace brake booster
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rear seat belt anchor screw not tightened (recall)
items.job: Replace and tighten rear seat belt anchor screws
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Loose shock absorber screws (recall)
items.job: Tighten shock absorber screw connections
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Water pump leak causing low boost
items.job: Replace water pump and contaminated vacuum lines

items.t: Turbocharger oil supply line leak
items.job: Replace turbocharger oil supply line and seals

items.t: Vacuum leak from crankcase ventilation (PCV)
items.job: Replace PCV valve or breather hoses

items.t: Excessive oil consumption on V6
items.job: Oil consumption test and diagnosis
items.note: If piston rings are the cause, an engine repair costs far more.

items.t: Misfire from failed ignition coil or worn spark plugs
items.job: Replace ignition coil(s) and spark plugs
items.note: Replacing a single coil costs less.

items.t: Driveshaft center bearing clunk and vibration
items.job: Replace driveshaft center support bearing or coupling

items.t: Air suspension sagging or compressor running constantly
items.job: Replace air spring, shock or valve block
items.note: A failed relay costs far less than a new compressor, so get it diagnosed first.

items.t: PDK shudder or jerky shifts at low speed
items.job: PDK software update and fluid change
items.note: Clutch or mechatronic replacement costs much more.

items.t: Infotainment (PCM) freezing or restarting
items.job: Repair or replace PCM infotainment unit
items.note: A software update or reset costs much less.

items.t: ABS and stability warning lights from wheel speed sensor
items.job: Replace wheel speed sensor

items.t: Exhaust chirp after revving
items.job: Replace exhaust brackets or mounts

items.t: Sunroof leaking into the cabin
items.job: Clear sunroof drain tubes
items.note: Water-damaged electronics or carpets cost extra.

items.t: Air conditioning not cooling well
items.job: A/C diagnosis and recharge
items.note: RepairPal lists an HVAC air door actuator at about $1,342-1,881 if a blend door is the fault.

items.t: Peeling trim and dash rattles
items.job: Replace or re-clip trim panels

items.t: Rearview camera blurry or blank on Macan Electric (recall)
items.job: Update control unit software and replace rearview camera as needed
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Headlights too bright for US rules on Macan Electric (recall)
items.job: Reprogram headlight control software
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Front seat airbag not fastened correctly (recall)
items.job: Check and correct airbag bracket screw
items.note: Free at a Porsche dealer under the recall. Check your VIN.
